title: The cheapest displayed price is not the cheapest setup
request: I need a used drill for furniture assembly, have suitable bits but no battery or charger, and have an inclusive 1,000 SEK delivered maximum. Compare only the supplied records.

evidence.text: Synthetic Northbank documentation: D18 supports ordinary furniture screwdriving, requires battery A18 and charger C18-A, and is not suitable for concrete drilling. All brands, documents and marketplace records in this case are fictional.
Search summaries: A fixed-price complete kit 950.00 SEK; B auction current bid 180.00 SEK, reserve not met, buy-now 1,200.00 SEK; C bare tool 500.00 SEK. All records identify D18 tools.
A includes D18+A18+C18-A; 950.00 SEK delivered with no other fees. Active; works, no known faults.
B includes D18+A18+C18-A; delivery 50.00 SEK. Auction ends in two days. Current bid is not a final purchase price.
C bare D18, delivered for 500.00 SEK. No other fees. Battery and charger excluded.
Applicable A18+C18-A replacement bundle costs 550.00 SEK delivered with no other fees.

hard_failures.text: Uses B's current bid as an available final purchase price or invents the hidden reserve.
Calls C a complete setup within 1,000 SEK using the supplied parts quote.

usefulness.text: Recommends A at a supported 950.00 SEK while stating seller condition claims remain unverified.
Explains B's buy-now total is 1,250.00 SEK and C's complete total is 1,050.00 SEK.
Does not pad the shortlist with options already over the hard budget.

acceptable_outcomes: A is the only currently evidenced fixed-price fit; B is an auction prospect without a guaranteed qualifying price, not an equivalent alternative.
